hook_en: Take heart: He keeps the faithful. 🙏
reflect_en: David ends this psalm by turning to everyone listening: love the LORD, because He preserves the faithful. If your hope is in Him today, you can be strong and courageous, even when the week feels heavy.
q_en: Where do you need courage from God today?
x_en: The LORD preserves the faithful… Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
tiktok: Be strong and courageous 🙏 Psalm 31:23–24 — if your hope is in the LORD, He keeps you
yt_title: Be Strong and Courageous, All You Who Hope in the LORD | Psalm 31:23–24 #Shorts
yt_line: Put your hope in Him today.
li_open: Courage is easier when you know who is holding you.
li_quote: The LORD preserves the faithful… Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
li_body: David's call to courage comes right after a reminder that God preserves the faithful. Leaders who hope in Him can face hard decisions with steady hearts, and a team that prays for one another helps each person find that courage too.
hook_es: Anímate: Él guarda a los fieles. 🙏
reflect_es: David termina este salmo hablándole a todos: amen a Jehová, porque Él guarda a los fieles. Si tu esperanza está en Él hoy, puedes esforzarte y tomar aliento, aunque la semana se sienta pesada.
q_es: ¿Para qué necesitas que Dios te dé ánimo hoy?
x_es: a los fieles guarda Jehová… Esforzaos todos vosotros los que esperáis en Jehová, y tome vuestro corazón aliento.
